g.text: py-app-banner-dranghek-abonnees | type banner | trim 2420 x 1550 mm, bleed 10 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: tien printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: dranghekspandoek-dubbelzijdig_01.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron ja). Template: trim 2420 x 1550 mm, bleed 10 mm, totaal 2440 x 1570 mm.

Variabelen: background-colour = #1A3580; front-nl = Alleen voor abonnees!; front-en = Subscribers only!; text = Bij storingen, bel naar; phone-number = 085 21 30 422; back-nl = Tot ziens; back-en = Goodbye

Print file of 2440 x 1570 mm (trim 2420 x 1550, 10 mm bleed set), CMYK, ONE version that holds both sides: the lower half (page y 775 to 1560) is the front and reads normally, the upper half (page y 10 to 775) is the back side and is rotated 180 degrees in the file (the back reads upside down), the two halves meet at the white fold line at y 775.
